title: PCI DSS Release-Time Source Watch
release_checks: Verify whether PCI DSS v4.0.1 remains the currently published standard.
Verify whether any successor standard or revision has become effective.
Verify current validation/supporting-document versions used by SAQ, ROC and AOC workflows.
Keep RFC, draft and future-change material non-normative until formally published and effective.
Verify Spanish and Portuguese official-library status and preserve English-prevails boundary where stated by PCI SSC.
Record verification date, reviewer, source URL, source title, version/effective date and disposition.
